overview_description.description:
Aegis Petroleum Technology is a Sino-foreign joint high-tech venture.

The business scope of Aegis covers the fields of various types of sewage treatment services. It is focused on the oil field waste drilling fluid, fracturing underground wastewater and tertiary oil recovery wastewater treatment. The company employs specific technology and complete equipment to deal with sewage disposal processes, and it also has proprietary intellectual property rights. It has formed the ability of offering one-stop services with conceptual design, installation, and trial run of projects and devices as well as integrated solutions of sewage disposal processes.

Aegis was established in 2009 in Zhangjiang High-tech Park, Shanghai.
